decision_headings: Aseptic, analytical, and cold-chain release gates
Utilities, materials, staffing, and staged restart

R01_authority.expected: Only the independent quality unit releases a lot; only the site head authorizes commercial restart after current evidence.

R02_process.expected: 72 percent is one observed batch; the gate is at least 68 percent in two consecutive engineering batches; harvest hold is six hours at 2-8 C.

R03_aseptic.expected: Zero contaminated units among 9,600 is one media fill; three consecutive fills are required; Grade A action and Grade B alert limits retain locations and units.

R04_cold_chain.expected: -70 C set point with -80 to -60 C allowed range; lane-4 reached -54 C for 22 minutes and requires stability review.

R05_utilities.expected: WFI is 82 C; every return must remain at least 80 C for three 30-minute windows; usable power is 5.4 MW versus 7.1 MW installed; generator is 3.2 MW for 28 hours.

R06_quality.expected: 91 percent potency is an observation within 85-115 percent; endotoxin 0.18 EU/mL is below 0.25 EU/mL; legacy 0.50 is superseded.

R07_cyber.expected: Service account disabled at 09:40 UTC; K7 signing key not exposed; break-glass expires after two hours with dual approval.

R08_supply.expected: Diesel covers 28 hours at emergency load and 17 at full production; stoppers cover 4.2 days, resin 2.6 batches; five operators start 05:30 +/-75 minutes.

R09_environment.expected: Notice is within 24 hours of determination; N-12 allows temporary neutralization; above 0.021 mg/L requires stop.

R10_observation.expected: 94 percent coverage leaves six percent unobserved; 81 C is warning and 79 C stop; latency is 640 ms p95 and 1,050 ms p99.

R11_communications.expected: 89 percent acknowledged leaves 11 percent communication uncertainty; hotline 1,800/hour for four hours versus forecast 2,400/hour.

R12_currentness.expected: Current candidate R9 binds B14/F8/U11/K7; older R8 evidence is historical unless transferred and rechecked; closure needs independent review and authorized acceptance.
